verses.original: הֹד֣וּ לַיהוָ֣ה כִּי־ ט֑וֹב כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: hō·ḏū Yah·weh kî- ṭō·wḇ kî lə·‘ō·w·lām ḥas·dōw
verses.literal: Give thanks to the LORD for He is good . . . His loving devotion endures forever
verses.literalPt: LOUVAI ao SENHOR, porque ele é bom, porque a sua benignidade dura para sempre.

verses.original: יֹ֭אמְרוּ גְּאוּלֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר גְּ֝אָלָ֗ם מִיַּד־ צָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: yō·mə·rū gə·’ū·lê Yah·weh ’ă·šer gə·’ā·lām mî·yaḏ- ṣār
verses.literal: Let the redeemed of the LORD say so whom He has redeemed from the hand of the enemy
verses.literalPt: Digam-no os remidos do SENHOR, os que remiu da mão do inimigo,

verses.original: וּֽמֵאֲרָצ֗וֹת קִ֫בְּצָ֥ם מִמִּזְרָ֥ח וּמִֽמַּעֲרָ֑ב מִצָּפ֥וֹן וּמִיָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ū·mê·’ă·rā·ṣō·wṯ qib·bə·ṣām mim·miz·rāḥ ū·mim·ma·‘ă·rāḇ miṣ·ṣā·p̄ō·wn ū·mî·yām
verses.literal: and gathered from the lands from east and west from north and south
verses.literalPt: E os que congregou das terras do oriente e do ocidente, do norte e do sul.

verses.original: תָּע֣וּ בַ֭מִּדְבָּר בִּישִׁימ֣וֹן דָּ֑רֶךְ עִ֥יר מ֝וֹשָׁ֗ב לֹ֣א מָצָֽאוּ׃
verses.transliteration: tā·‘ū ḇam·miḏ·bār bî·šî·mō·wn dā·reḵ ‘îr mō·wō·šāḇ lō mā·ṣā·’ū
verses.literal: Some wandered in desert wastelands finding no path to a city in which to dwell
verses.literalPt: Andaram desgarrados pelo deserto, por caminhos solitários; não acharam cidade para habitarem.

verses.original: רְעֵבִ֥ים גַּם־ צְמֵאִ֑ים נַ֝פְשָׁ֗ם בָּהֶ֥ם תִּתְעַטָּֽף׃
verses.transliteration: rə·‘ê·ḇîm gam- ṣə·mê·’îm nap̄·šām bā·hem tiṯ·‘aṭ·ṭāp̄
verses.literal: They were hungry and thirsty their soul fainted within them
verses.literalPt: Famintos e sedentos, a sua alma neles desfalecia.

verses.original: וַיִּצְעֲק֣וּ אֶל־ יְ֭הוָה בַּצַּ֣ר לָהֶ֑ם מִ֝מְּצֽוּקוֹתֵיהֶ֗ם יַצִּילֵֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiṣ·‘ă·qū ’el- Yah·weh baṣ·ṣar lā·hem mim·mə·ṣū·qō·w·ṯê·hem yaṣ·ṣî·lêm
verses.literal: Then they cried out to the LORD in their trouble and He delivered them from their distress
verses.literalPt: E clamaram ao SENHOR na sua angústia, e os livrou das suas dificuldades.

verses.original: וַ֭יַּֽדְרִיכֵם בְּדֶ֣רֶךְ יְשָׁרָ֑ה לָ֝לֶ֗כֶת אֶל־ עִ֥יר מוֹשָֽׁב׃
verses.transliteration: way·yaḏ·rî·ḵêm bə·ḏe·reḵ yə·šā·rāh lā·le·ḵeṯ ’el- ‘îr mō·wō·šāḇ
verses.literal: He led them on a straight path to reach . . . a city where they could live
verses.literalPt: E os levou por caminho direito, para irem a uma cidade de habitação.

verses.original: יוֹד֣וּ לַיהוָ֣ה חַסְדּ֑וֹ וְ֝נִפְלְאוֹתָ֗יו לִבְנֵ֥י אָדָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: yō·w·ḏū Yah·weh ḥas·dōw wə·nip̄·lə·’ō·w·ṯāw liḇ·nê ’ā·ḏām
verses.literal: Let them give thanks to the LORD for His loving devotion and His wonders to the sons of men
verses.literalPt: Louvem ao SENHOR pela sua bondade, e pelas suas maravilhas para com os filhos dos homens.

verses.original: כִּי־ הִ֭שְׂבִּיעַ נֶ֣פֶשׁ שֹׁקֵקָ֑ה וְנֶ֥פֶשׁ רְ֝עֵבָה מִלֵּא־ טֽוֹב׃
verses.transliteration: kî- hiś·bî·a‘ ne·p̄eš šō·qê·qāh wə·ne·p̄eš rə·‘ê·ḇāh mil·lê- ṭō·wḇ
verses.literal: For He satisfies the thirsty and fills the hungry with good things
verses.literalPt: Pois fartou a alma sedenta, e encheu de bens a alma faminta.

verses.original: יֹ֭שְׁבֵי חֹ֣שֶׁךְ וְצַלְמָ֑וֶת אֲסִירֵ֖י עֳנִ֣י וּבַרְזֶֽל׃
verses.transliteration: yō·šə·ḇê ḥō·šeḵ wə·ṣal·mā·weṯ ’ă·sî·rê ‘o·nî ū·ḇar·zel
verses.literal: Some sat in darkness and in the shadow of death prisoners in affliction and chains
verses.literalPt: Tal como a que se assenta nas trevas e sombra da morte, presa em aflição e em ferro;

verses.original: כִּֽי־ הִמְר֥וּ אִמְרֵי־ אֵ֑ל וַעֲצַ֖ת עֶלְי֣וֹן נָאָֽצוּ׃
verses.transliteration: kî- him·rū ’im·rê- ’êl wa·‘ă·ṣaṯ ‘el·yō·wn nā·’ā·ṣū
verses.literal: because they rebelled against the words of God and despised the counsel of the Most High
verses.literalPt: Porquanto se rebelaram contra as palavras de Deus, e desprezaram o conselho do Altíssimo.

verses.original: וַיַּכְנַ֣ע בֶּעָמָ֣ל לִבָּ֑ם כָּ֝שְׁל֗וּ וְאֵ֣ין עֹזֵֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yaḵ·na‘ be·‘ā·māl lib·bām kā·šə·lū wə·’ên ‘ō·zêr
verses.literal: He humbled their hearts with hard labor they stumbled and there was no one to help
verses.literalPt: Portanto, lhes abateu o coração com trabalho; tropeçaram, e não houve quem os ajudasse.

verses.original: וַיִּזְעֲק֣וּ אֶל־ יְ֭הוָה בַּצַּ֣ר לָהֶ֑ם מִ֝מְּצֻֽקוֹתֵיהֶ֗ם יוֹשִׁיעֵֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiz·‘ă·qū ’el- Yah·weh baṣ·ṣar lā·hem mim·mə·ṣu·qō·w·ṯê·hem yō·wō·šî·‘êm
verses.literal: Then they cried out to the LORD in their trouble and He saved them from their distress
verses.literalPt: Então clamaram ao SENHOR na sua angústia, e os livrou das suas dificuldades.

verses.original: יֽ֭וֹצִיאֵם מֵחֹ֣שֶׁךְ וְצַלְמָ֑וֶת וּמוֹסְר֖וֹתֵיהֶ֣ם יְנַתֵּֽק׃
verses.transliteration: yō·w·ṣî·’êm mê·ḥō·šeḵ wə·ṣal·mā·weṯ ū·mō·ws·rō·w·ṯê·hem yə·nat·têq
verses.literal: He brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death and broke away their chains . . .
verses.literalPt: Tirou-os das trevas e sombra da morte; e quebrou as suas prisões.

verses.original: יוֹד֣וּ לַיהוָ֣ה חַסְדּ֑וֹ וְ֝נִפְלְאוֹתָ֗יו לִבְנֵ֥י אָדָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: yō·w·ḏū Yah·weh ḥas·dōw wə·nip̄·lə·’ō·w·ṯāw liḇ·nê ’ā·ḏām
verses.literal: Let them give thanks to the LORD for His loving devotion and His wonders to the sons of men
verses.literalPt: Louvem ao SENHOR pela sua bondade, e pelas suas maravilhas para com os filhos dos homens.

verses.original: כִּֽי־ שִׁ֭בַּר דַּלְת֣וֹת נְחֹ֑שֶׁת וּבְרִיחֵ֖י בַרְזֶ֣ל גִּדֵּֽעַ׃
verses.transliteration: kî·ši- šib·bar dal·ṯō·wṯ nə·ḥō·šeṯ ū·ḇə·rî·ḥê ḇar·zel gid·dê·a‘
verses.literal: For He has broken down the gates of bronze and cut through the bars of iron
verses.literalPt: Pois quebrou as portas de bronze, e despedaçou os ferrolhos de ferro.

verses.original: אֱ֭וִלִים מִדֶּ֣רֶךְ פִּשְׁעָ֑ם וּֽ֝מֵעֲוֺֽנֹתֵיהֶ֗ם יִתְעַנּֽוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ĕ·wi·lîm mid·de·reḵ piš·‘ām ū·mê·‘ă·wō·nō·ṯê·hem yiṯ·‘an·nū
verses.literal: Fools in their rebellious ways and through their iniquities suffered affliction
verses.literalPt: Os loucos, por causa da sua transgressão, e por causa das suas iniqüidades, são aflitos.

verses.original: כָּל־ אֹ֭כֶל תְּתַעֵ֣ב נַפְשָׁ֑ם וַ֝יַּגִּ֗יעוּ עַד־ שַׁ֥עֲרֵי מָֽוֶת׃
verses.transliteration: kāl- ’ō·ḵel tə·ṯa·‘êḇ nap̄·šām way·yag·gî·‘ū ‘aḏ- ša·‘ă·rê mā·weṯ
verses.literal: They loathed all food and drew near to the gates of death
verses.literalPt: A sua alma aborreceu toda a comida, e chegaram até às portas da morte.

verses.original: וַיִּזְעֲק֣וּ אֶל־ יְ֭הוָה בַּצַּ֣ר לָהֶ֑ם מִ֝מְּצֻֽקוֹתֵיהֶ֗ם יוֹשִׁיעֵֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiz·‘ă·qū ’el- Yah·weh baṣ·ṣar lā·hem mim·mə·ṣu·qō·w·ṯê·hem yō·wō·šî·‘êm
verses.literal: Then they cried out to the LORD in their trouble . . . and He saved them from their distress
verses.literalPt: Então clamaram ao SENHOR na sua angústia, e ele os livrou das suas dificuldades.

verses.original: יִשְׁלַ֣ח דְּ֭בָרוֹ וְיִרְפָּאֵ֑ם וִֽ֝ימַלֵּ֗ט מִשְּׁחִיתוֹתָֽם׃׆
verses.transliteration: yiš·laḥ də·ḇā·rōw wə·yir·pā·’êm wî·mal·lêṭ miš·šə·ḥī·ṯō·ṯå̄m
verses.literal: He sent forth His word and healed them He rescued them from the Pit
verses.literalPt: Enviou a sua palavra, e os sarou; e os livrou da sua destruição.

verses.original: יוֹד֣וּ לַיהוָ֣ה חַסְדּ֑וֹ וְ֝נִפְלְאוֹתָ֗יו לִבְנֵ֥י אָדָֽם׃׆
verses.transliteration: yō·w·ḏū Yah·weh ḥas·dōw wə·nip̄·lə·’ō·w·ṯāw liḇ·nê ʾå̄·ḏå̄m
verses.literal: Let them give thanks to the LORD for His loving devotion and His wonders to the sons of men
verses.literalPt: Louvem ao SENHOR pela sua bondade, e pelas suas maravilhas para com os filhos dos homens.

verses.original: וְ֭יִזְבְּחוּ זִבְחֵ֣י תוֹדָ֑ה וִֽיסַפְּר֖וּ מַעֲשָׂ֣יו בְּרִנָּֽה׃׆
verses.transliteration: wə·yiz·bə·ḥū ziḇ·ḥê ṯō·w·ḏāh wî·sap·pə·rū ma·‘ă·śāw bə·rin·nå̄h
verses.literal: Let them offer sacrifices of thanksgiving and declare His works with rejoicing
verses.literalPt: E ofereçam os sacrifícios de louvor, e relatem as suas obras com regozijo.

verses.original: יוֹרְדֵ֣י הַ֭יָּם בָּאֳנִיּ֑וֹת עֹשֵׂ֥י מְ֝לָאכָ֗ה בְּמַ֣יִם רַבִּֽים׃׆
verses.transliteration: yō·wr·ḏê hay·yām bā·’o·nî·yō·wṯ ‘ō·śê mə·lā·ḵāh bə·ma·yim rab·bīm
verses.literal: Others went out to sea in ships conducting trade on the mighty waters
verses.literalPt: Os que descem ao mar em navios, mercando nas grandes águas.

verses.original: הֵ֣מָּה רָ֭אוּ מַעֲשֵׂ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וְ֝נִפְלְאוֹתָ֗יו בִּמְצוּלָֽה׃׆
verses.transliteration: hêm·māh rā·’ū ma·‘ă·śê Yah·weh wə·nip̄·lə·’ō·w·ṯāw bim·ṣū·lå̄h
verses.literal: They saw the works of the LORD and His wonders in the deep
verses.literalPt: Esses vêem as obras do SENHOR, e as suas maravilhas no profundo.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֗אמֶר וַֽ֭יַּעֲמֵד ר֣וּחַ סְעָרָ֑ה וַתְּרוֹמֵ֥ם גַּלָּֽיו׃׆
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer way·ya·‘ă·mêḏ rū·aḥ sə·‘ā·rāh wat·tə·rō·w·mêm gal·lå̄w
verses.literal: For He spoke and raised a tempest that lifted the waves of the sea
verses.literalPt: Pois ele manda, e se levanta o vento tempestuoso que eleva as suas ondas.

verses.original: יַעֲל֣וּ שָׁ֭מַיִם יֵרְד֣וּ תְהוֹמ֑וֹת נַ֝פְשָׁ֗ם בְּרָעָ֥ה תִתְמוֹגָֽג׃
verses.transliteration: ya·‘ă·lū šā·ma·yim yê·rə·ḏū ṯə·hō·w·mō·wṯ nap̄·šām bə·rā·‘āh ṯiṯ·mō·w·ḡāḡ
verses.literal: They mounted up to the heavens then sunk to the depths their courage melted in their anguish
verses.literalPt: Sobem aos céus; descem aos abismos, e a sua alma se derrete em angústias.

verses.original: יָח֣וֹגּוּ וְ֭יָנוּעוּ כַּשִּׁכּ֑וֹר וְכָל־ חָ֝כְמָתָ֗ם תִּתְבַּלָּֽע׃
verses.transliteration: yā·ḥō·w·gū wə·yā·nū·‘ū kaš·šik·kō·wr wə·ḵāl ḥā·ḵə·mā·ṯām tiṯ·bal·lā‘
verses.literal: They reeled and staggered like drunkards and all their skill was useless
verses.literalPt: Andam e cambaleiam como ébrios, e perderam todo o tino.

verses.original: וַיִּצְעֲק֣וּ אֶל־ יְ֭הוָה בַּצַּ֣ר לָהֶ֑ם וּֽ֝מִמְּצֽוּקֹתֵיהֶ֗ם יוֹצִיאֵֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiṣ·‘ă·qū ’el- Yah·weh baṣ·ṣar lā·hem ū·mim·mə·ṣū·qō·ṯê·hem yō·w·ṣî·’êm
verses.literal: Then they cried out to the LORD in their trouble and He brought them out of their distress
verses.literalPt: Então clamam ao SENHOR na sua angústia; e ele os livra das suas dificuldades.

verses.original: יָקֵ֣ם סְ֭עָרָה לִדְמָמָ֑ה וַ֝יֶּחֱשׁ֗וּ גַּלֵּיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: yā·qêm sə·‘ā·rāh liḏ·mā·māh way·ye·ḥĕ·šū gal·lê·hem
verses.literal: He calmed the storm to a whisper and the waves of the sea were hushed
verses.literalPt: Faz cessar a tormenta, e acalmam-se as suas ondas.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׂמְח֥וּ כִֽי־ יִשְׁתֹּ֑קוּ וַ֝יַּנְחֵ֗ם אֶל־ מְח֥וֹז חֶפְצָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiś·mə·ḥū ḵî- yiš·tō·qū way·yan·ḥêm ’el- mə·ḥō·wz ḥep̄·ṣām
verses.literal: They rejoiced in the silence and He guided them to the harbor they desired
verses.literalPt: Então se alegram, porque se aquietaram; assim os leva ao seu porto desejado.

verses.original: יוֹד֣וּ לַיהוָ֣ה חַסְדּ֑וֹ וְ֝נִפְלְאוֹתָ֗יו לִבְנֵ֥י אָדָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: yō·w·ḏū Yah·weh ḥas·dōw wə·nip̄·lə·’ō·w·ṯāw liḇ·nê ’ā·ḏām
verses.literal: Let them give thanks to the LORD for His loving devotion and His wonders to the sons of men
verses.literalPt: Louvem ao SENHOR pela sua bondade, e pelas suas maravilhas para com os filhos dos homens.

verses.original: וִֽ֭ירֹמְמוּהוּ בִּקְהַל־ עָ֑ם וּבְמוֹשַׁ֖ב זְקֵנִ֣ים יְהַלְלֽוּהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wî·rō·mə·mū·hū biq·hal- ‘ām ū·ḇə·mō·wō·šaḇ zə·qê·nîm yə·hal·lū·hū
verses.literal: Let them exalt Him in the assembly of the people and praise Him in the council of the elders
verses.literalPt: Exaltem-no na congregação do povo, e glorifiquem-no na assembléia dos anciãos.

verses.original: יָשֵׂ֣ם נְהָר֣וֹת לְמִדְבָּ֑ר וּמֹצָ֥אֵי מַ֝֗יִם לְצִמָּאֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: yā·śêm nə·hā·rō·wṯ lə·miḏ·bār ū·mō·ṣā·’ê ma·yim lə·ṣim·mā·’ō·wn
verses.literal: He turns rivers into deserts springs of water into thirsty ground
verses.literalPt: Ele converte os rios em um deserto, e as fontes em terra sedenta;

verses.original: אֶ֣רֶץ פְּ֭רִי לִמְלֵחָ֑ה מֵ֝רָעַ֗ת יֹ֣שְׁבֵי בָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: ’e·reṣ pə·rî lim·lê·ḥāh mê·rā·‘aṯ yō·šə·ḇê ḇāh
verses.literal: and fruitful land into fields of salt because of the wickedness of its dwellers
verses.literalPt: A terra frutífera em estéril, pela maldade dos que nela habitam.

verses.original: יָשֵׂ֣ם מִ֭דְבָּר לַֽאֲגַם־ מַ֑יִם וְאֶ֥רֶץ צִ֝יָּ֗ה לְמֹצָ֥אֵי מָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: yā·śêm miḏ·bār la·’ă·ḡam- ma·yim wə·’e·reṣ ṣî·yāh lə·mō·ṣā·’ê mā·yim
verses.literal: He turns a desert into pools of water and a dry land into flowing springs . . .
verses.literalPt: Converte o deserto em lagoa, e a terra seca em fontes.

verses.original: וַיּ֣וֹשֶׁב שָׁ֣ם רְעֵבִ֑ים וַ֝יְכוֹנְנ֗וּ עִ֣יר מוֹשָֽׁב׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·wō·šeḇ šām rə·‘ê·ḇîm way·ḵō·wn·nū ‘îr mō·wō·šāḇ
verses.literal: He causes the hungry to settle there that they may establish a city in which to dwell
verses.literalPt: E faz habitar ali os famintos, para que edifiquem cidade para habitação;

verses.original: וַיִּזְרְע֣וּ שָׂ֭דוֹת וַיִּטְּע֣וּ כְרָמִ֑ים וַ֝יַּעֲשׂ֗וּ פְּרִ֣י תְבֽוּאָה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiz·rə·‘ū śā·d̲ôt̲ way·yiṭ·ṭə·‘ū ḵə·rā·mîm way·ya·‘ă·śū pə·rî ṯə·ḇū·’āh
verses.literal: They sow fields and plant vineyards that yield a fruitful harvest
verses.literalPt: E semeiam os campos e plantam vinhas, que produzem fruto abundante.

verses.original: וַיְבָרֲכֵ֣ם וַיִּרְבּ֣וּ מְאֹ֑ד וּ֝בְהֶמְתָּ֗ם לֹ֣א יַמְעִֽיט׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḇā·ră·ḵêm way·yir·bū mə·’ōḏ ū·ḇə·hem·tām lō yam·‘îṭ
verses.literal: He blesses them and they multiply greatly He does not let their herds diminish
verses.literalPt: Também os abençoa, de modo que se multiplicam muito; e o seu gado não diminui.

verses.original: וַיִּמְעֲט֥וּ וַיָּשֹׁ֑חוּ מֵעֹ֖צֶר רָעָ֣ה וְיָגֽוֹן׃׆
verses.transliteration: way·yim·‘ă·ṭū way·yā·šō·ḥū mê·‘ō·ṣer rā·‘āh wə·yå̄·ḡōn
verses.literal: When they are decreased and humbled by oppression evil and sorrow
verses.literalPt: Depois se diminuem e se abatem, pela opressão, e aflição e tristeza.

verses.original: שֹׁפֵ֣ךְ בּ֭וּז עַל־ נְדִיבִ֑ים וַ֝יַּתְעֵ֗ם בְּתֹ֣הוּ לֹא־ דָֽרֶךְ׃
verses.transliteration: šō·p̄êḵ būz ‘al- nə·ḏî·ḇîm way·yaṯ·‘êm bə·ṯō·hū lō- ḏā·reḵ
verses.literal: He pours out contempt on the nobles and makes them wander in a trackless . . . wasteland
verses.literalPt: Derrama o desprezo sobre os príncipes, e os faz andar desgarrados pelo deserto, onde não há caminho.

verses.original: וַיְשַׂגֵּ֣ב אֶבְי֣וֹן מֵע֑וֹנִי וַיָּ֥שֶׂם כַּ֝צֹּ֗אן מִשְׁפָּחֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: way·śag·gêḇ ’eḇ·yō·wn mê·‘ō·w·nî way·yā·śem kaṣ·ṣōn miš·pā·ḥō·wṯ
verses.literal: But He lifts the needy from affliction and increases their families like flocks
verses.literalPt: Porém livra ao necessitado da opressão, em um lugar alto, e multiplica as famílias como rebanhos.

verses.original: יִרְא֣וּ יְשָׁרִ֣ים וְיִשְׂמָ֑חוּ וְכָל־ עַ֝וְלָ֗ה קָ֣פְצָה פִּֽיהָ׃
verses.transliteration: yir·’ū yə·šā·rîm wə·yiś·mā·ḥū wə·ḵāl ‘aw·lāh qā·p̄ə·ṣāh pî·hā
verses.literal: The upright see and rejoice and all iniquity shuts its mouth
verses.literalPt: Os retos o verão, e se alegrarão, e toda a iniqüidade tapará a boca.

verses.original: מִי־ חָכָ֥ם וְיִשְׁמָר־ אֵ֑לֶּה וְ֝יִתְבּֽוֹנְנ֗וּ חַֽסְדֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: mî- ḥā·ḵām wə·yiš·mār- ’êl·leh wə·yiṯ·bō·wn·nū ḥas·ḏê Yah·weh
verses.literal: Let him who is wise pay heed to these things and consider the loving devotion of the LORD
verses.literalPt: Quem é sábio observará estas coisas, e eles compreenderão as benignidades do SENHOR.
